name: Takasuga Yuusei
source:
He is a senior at the university where Chiho and Hidehito attend, and he is also the leader of the club they belong to.
He is a cheerful person with excellent social skills, and he is very kind to Chiho and Hidehito.
It seems he has a crush on Chiho, and after persistently trying to win her over, they end up dating.
